name: 1.0.0-rc.12
author: maya
body:
7 commits since [v1.0.0-rc.11](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/b5ff279e1a).

### 🐛 Bug fixes

- **release:** constrain selected adapters to the tested Effect runtime (#4002) ([aba067ea9c](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/aba067ea9c3b3b728654760462f10fbb8b57181e))
- **build:** accept pinned executable Effect peers for private adapters (#4002) ([364ed0f819](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/364ed0f819a976700caaff749acae80bbd6f3f1c))
- **backend:** a review is read back by its own id, and dated against a pre-write witness (#4038) ([c05e18cb23](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/c05e18cb23ae5ff8034791309242dd876b3fdcba))

### 📝 Documentation

- **release:** prepare rc.12 with validated adapter contracts (#4042) ([e432cfdb4d](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/e432cfdb4de0ce5283a0bd4499ac8063ba532f21))
- **release:** record rc.11 build failure and adapter blocker (#4042) ([6763f53e5b](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/6763f53e5b5a981621e7e2d5159ea9df45478116))

### 📦 Other changes

- **style(docs):** format the pinned Bun adapter requirements (#4002) ([79242bf621](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/79242bf621be200437d43fdd9610b3c0bcdb2ca9))
- **test(backend):** the recorded review is proved field by field, and a create answered 200 is the same act (#4038) ([61fee138c7](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/61fee138c71c838677b50a68344a78624586b9af))

name: 1.0.0-rc.11
author: maya
body:
13 commits since [v1.0.0-rc.10](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/9346ce20b6).

### ✨ Features

- **app,backend:** review the actual GitHub pull request, not the native landing of the same number ([d85aedb07f](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/d85aedb07f631feef1c57ec6e5de47aebd170bf3))
- **app:** let a repository flow own notification policy (#4026) ([2ac058bac3](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/2ac058bac3a7ca07f8fde773fadfd6cbba35901d))

### 🐛 Bug fixes

- **release:** pin executable Effect peers to their tested runtime (#4002) ([d40b1e7318](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/d40b1e7318df59a3087b20e24de156b2a537cb7b))
- **backend,app:** one GitHub mutation per human intent, at the head the person read, under the operation's own policy (#4027, #4038) ([316b77b1d5](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/316b77b1d53960502a2690120dcf2f96368d59d2))
- **app:** a repository flow moves its own issues on GitHub, and the repository says which tracker a number means (#4027, #4030) ([d5a27f011c](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/d5a27f011cc3714669ddb041a88d294bafde3e6c))
- **server:** launch the release-gate probe subprocesses by absolute interpreter path ([62ffe8a65f](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/62ffe8a65fd0ddee6a1c4b8d6f86ba9c5bdcbcfa))
- **flows:** make the notification policy example compile in the repository that copies it (#4026) ([59fd9d20c9](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/59fd9d20c95887ffa34d4a299f0a27890c3a3236))
- **app:** bound the notification policy's declaration read and fence its refusals (#4026) ([0c522de145](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/0c522de145771ef08af9b90d6775c403f4998afc))
- **app:** fence, bound and honour a repository notification policy (#4026) ([dfae23b97e](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/dfae23b97ed686eccf1608ce1fe53b4ffd44e89d))

### 📝 Documentation

name: 1.0.0-rc.10
author: maya
body:
### ✨ Features

- **monitor:** serve a repository own run index so hosted monitoring reads actual runs (#4032) ([4bda4b790b](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/4bda4b790bead7fca5da382fc950e7818ef75e4d))

- **app:** / launches repositories and real Smithers news; a repository opens on its own view ([e03092e267](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/e03092e2677f7d6d5191ec3f7a4d6db0f81e6bf5))
- **app:** a GitHub URL Smithers doesn't have offers the step that exists ([75981f8ec4](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/75981f8ec4dfe329d4c754960daff9fed9eb2a64))
- **cli:** scaffold imported typed MDX prompts (#2271) ([7b25ed0f60](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/7b25ed0f60022d7c4d350d94b198619bbf9a9536))

### 🐛 Bug fixes

- **app:** open GitHub-shaped PR and issue URLs after repository admission (#4039) ([a23a203c13](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/a23a203c132ece77fda17d843b3274c9d96a98d4))

- **app:** preserve navigation durability and align authority fixtures (#4040) ([7ad5b5c9e8](https://github.com/smithersai/smithers/commit/7ad5b5c9e8ee30038bb8daa31f5cdf6f32beb774))
